key_insight: A multimodal cardiac foundation model pretrained on signals and textual interpretations from 1.7 million individuals enables accurate, device‑agnostic heart assessment across hospital and at‑home settings.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap caused by heterogeneous cardiac data (clinical ECGs vs. consumer wearable signals) and limited labeled datasets, delivering robust, generalizable cardiac interpretation across devices and scenarios.
method: Pretrained a multimodal model on heart signals paired with textual interpretations from ~1.7 million individuals to learn shared signal–language representations.
Aligned signal and report modalities (self-/contrastive-style learning) to enable interpretation, transfer and zero/few‑shot generalization across device types and settings.
Validated cross-device, cross-scenario performance showing consistent diagnostic insights for both hospital-grade ECGs and consumer wearable recordings.
impact: Provides a scalable foundation for deploying cardiac AI that generalizes across devices and care settings, reducing the need for device-specific retraining and accelerating clinical and consumer health applications.
